title: Answer: experience is how one is aware of one's states

statements.text: Experience, in the sense of there being something it is like, is how one's mental life appears to one, fixed by the content of the higher-order awareness. Mental qualities themselves are not experience and occur without being conscious.

sources.quote: A state’s being conscious is a matter of mental appearance
Knowing what it is like to be in a state is knowing what it is like to be aware of being in that state.
